default.notes: B1/B2 visitor visa required ($185); interview wait times at US consulates can run to several months — apply early.

groups.notes: Visa Waiver Program: an approved ESTA ($21, valid 2 years) is required before travel; stays up to 90 days, not extendable.
Compact of Free Association: citizens may enter, live and work in the United States without a visa.
Entry to the US is suspended for this nationality under the June 2025 presidential proclamation — new visitor visas are generally not being issued; limited exemptions apply.
B1/B2 visitor visa required ($185); the June 2025 presidential proclamation partially suspends visa issuance for this nationality — expect extra scrutiny and possible refusal.

CA.notes: Canadian citizens need neither a visa nor an ESTA for tourism or business visits of up to 6 months.

BS.notes: Bahamian citizens clearing US preclearance in the Bahamas can normally enter without a visa; travel from other countries requires a B1/B2 visa.
